title: Stamp collection
description: Every country you visit adds a stamp to your collection.
emptyHint: Mark a country as Visited or Lived to collect its stamp.
noResultsHint: Try another country name or change the filter.
completeHint: Your collection includes every country and territory in Past Pins.
coverage: One stamp for each country or territory in the app. Regions do not add separate stamps.
collectedHint: Collected because you marked this country Visited or Lived. Its stamp follows changes to your travel status.
notCollectedHint: Mark this country Visited or Lived to collect its stamp. Wishlist does not collect a stamp.
artworkNote: A keepsake inspired by passport stamps.
